subject.title: [Bug] Telegram exec approval bubble not dismissed after clicking approve

question: Should maintainers close/adopt the conflicting open fork PR before allowing a new narrow fix for this Telegram approval deletion bug?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and small, but an open linked fork PR with closing syntax is still present and targets an obsolete handler path, so automation should not create a competing fix until maintainers choose that path.

options.title: Close fork PR and allow replacement
options.body: Close or abandon the conflicting fork PR, then permit a narrow replacement against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with live Telegram proof.

options.title: Adopt and rewrite fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer or contributor replace the fork PR's obsolete handler-path patch with the active-runtime `delete` final-action shape before review continues.

options.title: Keep issue parked
options.body: Leave the issue open without a new fix lane until a maintainer has time to resolve the linked PR state manually.

recommendation.title: Close fork PR and allow replacement
recommendation.body: Close or abandon the conflicting fork PR, then permit a narrow replacement against `extensions/telegram/src/approval-handler.runtime.ts` with live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the native approval lifecycle and active Telegram runtime seam that the fix should use.
